source_judgments: R871 requires named slash-delimited groups and nonempty object lists; its intergroup comma is optional. R872 uses explicit R903/C903 whole variable-name, not a selector, declarator, arbitrary expression or assumed group-name wrapper.

C8107's USE-associated group-name exclusion does not prohibit associated member variables or imported-group I/O use. A locally declared host-homonym group can be a different local entity; concatenation is same-scope.
C8108 requires a genuine assumed-size dummy, with a complete module/explicit-interface assumed-shape repair. Replacing it by a selected element is not an R872 repair.

C8109 concerns enumeration type, not enum type or integer enumerators. Direct components recurse through nonpointer nonallocatable derived components, including parent components. An immediate enumeration-typed pointer or allocatable component remains direct.

A pointer/allocatable derived-component hop cuts deeper direct-component recursion, but does not establish legal I/O transfer. Defined I/O does not waive C8109; future controls retain complete actual enumeration definitions.

12.6.4.7p2 governs transfer state for the whole group: every allocatable group object is allocated and every pointer group object is associated, even if omitted from an input record. Polymorphic or pointer/allocatable-ultimate-component objects need defined I/O.

The five S requirements retain output object order, one value per repeated occurrence, concatenated same-scope declarations, prior type/kind/rank routes and conditional later implicit confirmation. Purpose and multi-group membership permission do not create extra no-op S effects.

NAMELIST READ-back alone cannot prove output order or multiplicity: reordering, omission and overwriting can preserve final values. The independent counterexamples are source reasoning, not executed parsers or fixtures.

The proposed observer retains intrinsic uppercase names, group/assignment structure and independent literal/name/sequence expectations while allowing legal spacing, separators, widths, records and array-value compression. Repeated scalar occurrences cannot be replaced by scalar input with repeat count greater than one under13.11.3.3p2.

CHARACTER/REAL/COMPLEX, DECIMAL/DELIM and defined-I/O output retain separate gates. Full scratch-I/O lifecycle, IOSTAT/EOF/completion and passing-parent wrong-value/order/omission sensitivity remain unimplemented.

P5 requires prior declared type, kind parameters and rank through association, prior statements or implicit typing; it does not require all storage/length/payload information. Later confirmation is conditional on implicit typing, not permission to replace a prior explicit type.
All47facets remain pending. No source graph, canonical-case reuse, numbered wrapper, I/O execution or mandatory fatal-diagnostic policy is approved.
